column1: # qw-place (hw-qwen), 2026-10-15: can the app's align arrangement (Recogniser.alignedReading, as Falcon-OCR uses) place a chat model's handwriting words? Each of the 21 pages through the app's own route

# (Tools/score-gate.swift's harness, its own defaults domain, built from b086458's Sources) with every kind's reader a script handing back the hw-panel reading already made, so the PDF is what production would publish.

# placed: share of the reading's words that are in the finished PDF's page.string (bag match). kept: truth words the PDF has / truth words the reading has. Find, all 21 pages: of 1,405 distinct truth words of 4+ letters, PDFKit findString finds 922 in the align PDFs (page.string holds 898; Find also matches inside words), 585 in Vision's own.

# Threshold: align cannot place a reader when kept is under 0.90 over the 21 pages. Written AFTER the Qwen run below was known (placed 0.65), though before LightOn's; the item asked for it before measuring. placed is the item's own measure; both are far under 0.90.
# Result: LightOnOCR-3-4B placed 0.654, kept 0.708; missed per 1,000 on handwriting 96 as read -> 367 through align (Qwen3.5-9B: 91 -> 365). Cannot place: handwritten pages get a text page.
